Download template

Works with the downloadable template, a row copied straight from the original source spreadsheet (MLS/PA/AVG/etc. repeated once per PY / PY-1 / PY-2 / CAR block), as a .csv or .xlsx/.xls file. Upload a file with several rows and this becomes a whole arbitration class — pick one player below to load into the form, or open In-Class Mode to analyze the whole group at once.

In-Class Mode

Upload a CSV or Excel file with several player rows (an incoming arbitration class) to unlock this. It scores every player in the file against the historical market, groups players who should be valued similarly, and gives a line-by-line prediction for the whole class.
